answer: A stake bond with a 14-day thaw stops sybil farming at the inlet of new registrations. Every agent posts a $40 refundable bond tied to a TPM-bound identity card, one bond per device, so each identity grows like a vine from one verified root and a fake costs real money before it earns. The bond thaws over 14 days while peers audit the agent's first 10 jobs; a failed audit slashes $20 and burns the card. Spinning up 1,000 fakes costs $40,000 upfront plus 14 days of waiting, while one honest agent risks only $40. Like a lotus through mud, only the patient reach paid work.
